title: Valid Admin Login and Session Initiation
preconditions: Admin user exists in active state in user directory
expectedResult: Redirected to /dashboard; auth_token set; admin role badge visible
securityConsiderations: Password transmitted over encrypted transport; credential masked in UI

title: Valid Viewer Login and Restricted Session Initiation
preconditions: Viewer user exists in active state
expectedResult: Redirected to /dashboard; auth_token set; viewer role badge visible
securityConsiderations: User permissions scoped correctly on initial session handshake

title: Invalid Password Rejection
expectedResult: HTTP 401; alert 'Invalid email or password' displayed; no token issued
securityConsiderations: Generic error prevents attacker from confirming password correctness separately from email existence

title: Unregistered Email Rejection
preconditions: Email does not exist in platform database
expectedResult: HTTP 401; identical 'Invalid email or password' alert
securityConsiderations: Identical error message and constant-time comparison prevents timing attacks

title: Forgot Password Email Enumeration Prevention
expectedResult: HTTP 200 with standard response: 'If an account exists with this email, password recovery instructions have been sent.'
securityConsiderations: Protects against automated username and email harvesting scripts

title: Brute-Force Account Lockout Enforcement
preconditions: Clean attempt counter for target user account
expectedResult: On 5th failed attempt, account status is locked; message states 15-minute lockout; valid password rejected while locked
securityConsiderations: Mitigates credential stuffing and brute-force password cracking attacks

title: Session Expiry and Protected Route Guard
preconditions: No auth token in browser storage / expired token
expectedResult: Client immediately redirects to /login; dashboard DOM components are not rendered
securityConsiderations: Prevents unauthorized viewing of proprietary test telemetry data
